# barrel (cloudspider-barrel) v1.0.0

An empty bucket. Its own stack, not the test VPC and not the EKS stack.

## Inputs

Set with `pulumi config set <key> <value>` or the STACKS card. Validated before any resource is created (upgrades/schema); the card runs the same check before it makes the stack.

| key | allowed | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| name | must be a short lowercase name (a-z, 0-9, -; 2-28 chars, starts with a letter) | cloudspider-barrel | bucket name prefix |
| protectData | on \| off | on | protect the data resources (refuses destroy/replace; TAKE IT DOWN unprotects first) |

## Outputs

- `bucketName`

## Guarantees

- Providers pinned: `@pulumi/aws` 6.83.4, `@pulumi/pulumi` 3.268.0 (package-lock.json).
- Data is protected (`protectData`, default on): a hand-run destroy or replace is refused; the card's TAKE IT DOWN unprotects first.
- Policy pack: `pulumi preview --policy-pack ../policy-pack`.
- Tested under Pulumi mocks: upgrades/iac-matrix.json.

See CHANGELOG.md.
